subject: Re: NovaEdge renewal — executive approval for one-time credit & SLA addendum
messages:
From: Eliot Song <eliot.song@novaedge.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@novaedge.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window — helping us avoid a product downgrade

Hey Stephanie,

Quick note from NovaEdge as our renewal window approaches (renewal effective 2028-07-31). Usage has increased 2.6x this year and our CFO is pressing for predictable unit cost — we have a competing offer on the table that beats our current blended rate.

We like Redwood's reliability, but we need a one-time commercial concession to make the math work this year: a one-time credit applied to the renewal invoice and an SLA addendum guaranteeing 99.95% for the most critical API routes for 12 months. Can you share what levers are realistic? We need your best offer by EOD Wednesday (6/14) to brief procurement.

Eliot
Senior Ops, NovaEdge

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Eliot Song <eliot.song@novaedge.com>
Cc: Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@novaedge.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window — helping us avoid a product downgrade

Eliot — thanks for the heads up and the clarity on timing. I appreciate the candid signal on competitive pressure.

Short answer: we can put together a one-time credit and an SLA addendum, but I need to loop in our deal desk and ask for an executive approval for the scale you describe. I attached a quick usage summary (what we've seen on your account) and a preliminary draft of an SLA addendum that limits the scope to your "critical-API" surface so we can be surgical on risk.

Proposed save package (internal note: outline for approval):
- One-time invoice credit equal to 10% of committed ARR (applied at renewal invoice)
- SLA addendum: 99.95% availability commitment for routes /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings (12 months) with a credit schedule for breaches
- Operational commitment: weekly health sync for first 90 days + priority routing to dedicated pool during peak windows

If you can confirm you accept this package in principle, I will start an exec escalation to secure authorization and provide final legal language. We aim to respond with final terms by EOD 6/14.

Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 12:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: NovaEdge renewal — exec approval requested

Looping the deal desk and finance owners —

Summary: NovaEdge asks for a one-time credit (~10% of ARR) + SLA addendum scoped to two routes and operational priority for 12 months. They are a mid-enterprise account, current ARR $1.2M, ARR expansion opportunity next year if we preserve the relationship. Counterfactual: if we decline or delay, they are evaluating a public-cloud-native competitor that can undercut per-token rate.

Attachments: proposed_one_time_credit_schedule.xlsx (draft), novaedge_q2_usage_summary.csv (from Stephanie), redwood_sla_addendum_draft.docx (SLA template)

Requesting: Vivek/Marissa — can you review and confirm approval level? Specifically we need authorization for the credit percentage + signoff on SLA risk envelope. I recommend approval at the requested level; commercial benefit is retention and expected upsell.

Thanks,
Monica

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: NovaEdge renewal — exec approval requested

Thanks for the recap. A few quick questions before I sign off:
1) Confirm net ARR delta if we grant 10% one-time credit (we need to know TCV/ARR math and payback).
2) Any operational constraints or capacity guarantees we must make to ensure we can hit 99.95% for those routes? Will this require reserved capacity (Dedicated) or is routing/pinning sufficient?
3) Is there precedent for this size of one-time credit in the last 12 months (benchmarks)?

Marissa — Monica and Stephanie recommended approval; if you can provide a short note on legal/contract risk and whether the draft SLA addendum needs additional redlines, I can approve contingent on verifying the ARR impact.

Vivek
VP, Sales Operations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 14:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: NovaEdge renewal — exec approval requested

Vivek — quick answers below and recommended approval path.

1) ARR math: Current committed ARR = $1.2M. One-time credit = 10% of ARR -> $120k credit applied at renewal. Net ARR for year stays $1.2M; cash impact is one-time reduction of invoice (impact to FY28 revenue recognition to be reviewed with finance) but retention avoids a ~$1.05M churn.

2) Operational constraints: scoped SLA to two routes only. We can meet 99.95% via prioritized scheduling + lightweight dedicated pool during prime hours. Cost estimate for reserved pool: ~$8k/month incremental; covered by savings target margin.

3) Precedent: Similar one-time credits of 7–12% were authorized for two strategic accounts YTD (see Confluence note). Risk: SLA credit language must cap total payouts and include exclusion for customer-driven rate-limits/abuse. Legal redlines suggested in the draft: limit credits to fixed monthly cap, carveout for planned maintenance with 24-hr notice, and require furnishing of traffic patterns quarterly.

Recommendation: Authorize the requested 10% one-time credit and SLA addendum with the suggested legal redlines. Finance to sign off on revenue recognition treatment.

Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Commercial Deals

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Eliot Song <eliot.song@novaedge.com>, Ana Ruiz <ana.ruiz@novaedge.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Executives — request for final sign-off (NovaEdge renewal, DEAL-2028-NE-4789)

All — per the internal recommendations above, NovaEdge has verbally accepted the save package in principle. We have DocuSign ready and the customer is waiting for the final confirmation today.

One-line ask for approval: authorize a one-time credit equal to 10% of ARR ($120k) applied to the renewal invoice, and approve the SLA addendum (99.95% for two routes, with capped remedy schedule and legal redlines as proposed).

Why approve: retention and high probability of expansion in 2029; avoiding churn preserves ~$1.05M ARR and maintains a strong case study in health-tech vertical. Operational mitigation in place (priority routing + small reserved pool).

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/doc/NE-4789-approval
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deals/DEAL-2028-NE-4789

Please reply-all with APPROVE or REJECT. If I don't see a REJECT by 19:00 PT today, I will assume approval and send to legal/finance to finalize the DocuSign packet.

Thanks —
Stephanie
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: proposed_one_time_credit_schedule.xlsx (draft), redwood_sla_addendum_draft.docx (draft), novaedge_q2_usage_summary.csv
